items.title: Live: Trump warns 'whole civilisation will die' if Iran does not do deal
items.description: The US president says "we will find out tonight" whether Iran has agreed to a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with his deadline set to expire in a matter of hours. Follow live.

items.title: Iran briefing with Matthew Doran: Middle East on the brink as Trump's deadline is hours away
items.description: Warning sirens are sounding and preparations are being made as the US and Iran ratchet up the threats against each other.

items.title: 'Huge mistake': Trump's latest Iran threats prompt political allies to push back
items.description: Donald Trump says a "whole civilisation will die" if the US and Iran do not reach a deal in the coming hours — another escalation in the threat to harm Iran's population if its rulers do not comply.

items.title: How much it costs to fill up Australia's top selling cars
items.description: The ABC has analysed how the cost of filling up Australia's most purchased cars of 2025 has changed since the beginning of the Iran war.

items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith's fight against war crimes allegations just got more perilous
items.description: During his years-long battle to clear his name, a separate joint investigation stretching 9,000 kilometres was discreetly transpiring.

items.title: Matt Canavan looks to stars for 'Australia on steroids' plan
items.description: A domestic space industry, a baby boom, new dams and more factories are on Nationals leader Matt Canavan's to-do list to deliver what he describes as an Australian economic revolution.

items.title: Having seen prisons from the inside, Zach says they're just 'breeding criminals'
items.description: Hundreds of legal, health and children's organisations are calling on Anthony Albanese to convene an emergency summit to address the over-incarceration of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children.

items.title: Farmers angered by plans to turn coal mine into lake bigger than Sydney Harbour
items.description: There are plans to turn the former Hazelwood coal mine in Victoria into a lake bigger than Sydney Harbour, but farmers and environmentalists are worried about the impact on nearby waterways.

items.title: Outback tensions rise as national parks expansion reshapes communities
items.description: Hailed as a win for the environment, $200 million has been spent purchasing new national parks in outback NSW — but not everyone is celebrating.

items.title: Boards make moves affecting the nation but look like a golf club committee
items.description: There's a push to get younger people, women and more diverse community members on the boards making the big decisions in Australian life.

items.title: Tourists urged not to cancel plans as Cyclone Maila nears Far North Qld
items.description: Severe Tropical Cyclone Maila is expected to cross into Far North Queensland on Sunday, but with a likely limited impact

items.title: Elite sportswoman 'felt like a fraud' promoting her sport while playing for nothing
items.description: Recently retired rugby union player Mel Kawa regularly broke down in tears, grappling with her love of the game and the $2,000 she was paid to play it.

items.title: Seller disclosure laws driving unethical behaviour, Qld real estate agents say
items.description: Real estate experts say Queensland's seller disclosure laws, which were introduced in August, are fuelling 'gazumping' and leading to unnecessary costs.

items.title: Calls to force NDIS providers to register as Labor eyes savings
items.description: Stricter registration rules would weed out low-quality NDIS providers while delivering better services and budget savings, major operators say.

items.title: 'I just had to do it for me': The ambiguous loss of family estrangement
items.description: Estrangement usually begins after a significant traumatic experience with a loved one, experts say.

items.title: Quiz: Pack your suitcase, we're going on a trip
items.description: Which European microstate is smaller? And which US president isn’t on Mount Rushmore?

items.title: Award-winning musical scores elevate a new generation of video games
items.description: Art director Matt Nava and composer Austin Wintory reveal how their cult 2012 video game Journey shaped their latest offering, the Grammy Award-winning Sword of the Sea.

items.title: Tourism industry council warns sector at 'tipping point'
items.description: According to the Queensland Tourism Industry Council (QTIC), many operators are struggling to remain afloat as they grapple with rising operating costs and cancellations, along with the ongoing fuel crisis.

items.title: Passengers vomiting 'up and down' aisles as Fiji flight aborts three landings
items.description: A Fiji Airways flight from Sydney had to divert after bad weather from a tropical cyclone thwarted its attempts to land.

items.title: Police 'recommence' reporting of child abuse by staff after eight-month gap
items.description: The child safety regulator sought a law change after receiving "concerning" correspondence from Tasmania Police, which said its officers were not bound by a key child protection measure.

items.title: 'We can't even get pads': The hidden crisis facing Myanmar women
items.description: Women who had already lost their homes to last year's earthquake are now also cut off from essentials like sanitary pads and aid.

items.title: Police charge international baby trafficking syndicate in Indonesia
items.description: Babies, some as young as three months, were allegedly sold to people in Singapore and across Indonesia.

items.title: Thousands of sites taken down as experts warn AI is increasing scams
items.description: Almost 12,000 scam websites have been shut down by Australia's financial regulator in a year as it continues a "cat-and-mouse game" with cybercriminals.

items.title: Kanye West blocked from entering UK to headline music festival
items.description: The British government's decision forces London's Wireless festival to cancel the event.

items.title: David Warner charged with mid-range drink driving
items.description: Former Australian Test cricketer David Warner is charged with mid-range drink driving in Sydney's east over the weekend.
